description: Treat a candidate forcing pair as a deterministic anisotropic bootstrap-percolation rule on the product grid underlying the constructible graph. The CA is only a proposer: once a droplet grows across the grid, an exact extractor converts the growth history into legal edge relations and seed generators, then measures the true score.
mathematical_formalization: Choose an update family \mathcal{U}_X on V = [d_1]\times\cdots\times[d_k]. A site v becomes active if there exists a local pattern P\in\mathcal{U}_X with P+v \subseteq A_t. Compile A_\infty into a relation lattice L(A_\infty)\subseteq \mathbb{Z}^{2|V|}, and accept only if \forall v\in V,\ (1,-1)e_v \in \operatorname{span}_{\mathbb{Z}}(L(A_\infty)\cup R_0) with support constraints respected. Optimize S=(m+r)/(n-t).
analogical_connections: Critical droplets in bootstrap percolation play the role of minimal forcing motifs.
The CA activation front is analogous to a proof shell that exposes new exact linear relations.
Slow percolation schedules suggest low-overhead stage orders for the constructible graph.
implementation_hypothesis: Enumerate low-height slope sets X and small anisotropic update families on 2D product grids. For each family, simulate growth from candidate seeds, record the activation DAG, and compile each activated local move into the corresponding relation insertion allowed by the verifier.
experiment_seed: Start with d=(6,6) and X drawn from {(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(2,1),(1,2)} minus forbidden sums. Score candidate droplets by extracted S, not by fill time; keep only motifs whose exact compilation reaches every vertex.

closest_prior_art.title: Universality for two-dimensional critical cellular automata
Sharp Metastability Threshold for Two-Dimensional Bootstrap Percolation
Pattern Problems related to the Arithmetic Kakeya Conjecture

novelty_claim: The new step is to compile anisotropic droplet growth into exact arithmetic Kakeya certificates, rather than using bootstrap percolation only as an analogy or threshold theorem.
differentiation: This is not a reimplementation of universality or metastability results because the objective is not a threshold or infection time. The search target is an exact legal witness minimizing (m+r)/(n-t), with extraction constraints that percolation papers do not address.
